environmentVariables.description: Response size tier controlling token usage.

environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_API_VERSION

environmentVariables.description: HTTP/HTTPS proxy URL for all OpenGrok API requests (e.g. http://proxy.company.com:8080). Also set as HTTPS_PROXY.
environmentVariables.name: HTTP_PROXY

environmentVariables.description: Force a specific response format for all tools. Leave unset for per-tool auto-selection (recommended).
environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_RESPONSE_FORMAT_OVERRIDE

environmentVariables.description: Directory where the AI stores investigation notes (active-task.md, investigation-log.md). Defaults to ~/.config/opengrok-mcp/memory-bank/ or workspace-relative when set by the VS Code extension.
environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_MEMORY_BANK_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated paths to compile_commands.json for C/C++ compiler flag and include-path extraction. Leave unset for automatic workspace discovery.
environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_LOCAL_COMPILE_DB_PATHS

environmentVariables.description: Interactive AI Prompts — the AI pauses to ask questions during investigations (project selection, file disambiguation). Requires Claude Code v2.1.76+ or a client that supports MCP Elicitation.
environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_ENABLE_ELICITATION

environmentVariables.description: AI Sampling — allow the server to request LLM completions for error explanations and summaries. Off by default to avoid consuming premium requests (e.g. GitHub Copilot).
environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_ENABLE_SAMPLING

environmentVariables.description: Model preference for MCP Sampling (used for error explanation and query reformulation).
environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_SAMPLING_MODEL

environmentVariables.description: Files API Cache — avoids re-uploading unchanged investigation notes. Requires Files API support in the MCP client.
environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_ENABLE_FILES_API

environmentVariables.description: Observation Masker — prepend compact history summaries to opengrok_execute results after N turns. Disabled by default; has no benefit for clients that retain full context (Claude Code, Cursor).
environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_ENABLE_OBSERVATION_MASKER

environmentVariables.description: Number of most-recent opengrok_execute results to keep as full text before masking older ones. Default: 10.
environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_OBSERVATION_MASKER_TURNS

environmentVariables.description: Maximum tokens for AI sampling responses (error explanation, query reformulation). Range: 64–4096.
environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_SAMPLING_MAX_TOKENS

environmentVariables.description: Path to write structured audit events (CSV/JSON). Appends tool invocations, elicitation events, and errors. Leave unset to disable.
environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_AUDIT_LOG_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Maximum requests per minute to the OpenGrok server. Default: 60.
environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_RATELIMIT_RPM

environmentVariables.description: Per-tool rate limits in requests per minute, as comma-separated tool:rpm pairs (e.g. opengrok_execute:15,opengrok_search_code:30). Overrides OPENGROK_RATELIMIT_RPM for specific tools.
environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_PER_TOOL_RATELIMIT

environmentVariables.description: HTTP request timeout in seconds for OpenGrok API calls. Increase for slow servers. Default: 30.
environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_TIMEOUT

environmentVariables.description: Default maximum number of results returned per search query. Default: 25.
environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_DEFAULT_MAX_RESULTS

environmentVariables.description: Path to a file containing the OpenGrok password (file-mounted secret for containers). Takes precedence over the OS keychain when OPENGROK_PASSWORD is unset.
environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_PASSWORD_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Hard cap on response payload size in bytes. Overrides the context-budget default. Non-positive values are ignored.

environmentVariables.description: Cap for the search_and_read compound tool in bytes. Overrides the context-budget default (2–8 KB depending on tier). Non-positive values are ignored.
environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_SEARCH_AND_READ_CAP

environmentVariables.description: When true, reject OPENGROK_BASE_URL values pointing at private/loopback IPs at startup. Default: false (warn only; per-request guards still apply).
environmentVariables.name: OPENGROK_STRICT_SSRF

environmentVariables.description: Expected JWT issuer (iss claim) for HTTP transport OAuth. When set, JWTs from other issuers are rejected.

server.name: io.github.IlyasKhallouki/hypruse
server.description: Computer use for Hyprland: semantic desktop state over IPC, plus vision and native input
server.title: hypruse

environmentVariables.description: How captures are returned: 'file' writes to XDG_RUNTIME_DIR and returns the path, 'image' returns the image inline. Use 'image' for clients that render MCP images but cannot read files, such as Claude Desktop.
environmentVariables.name: HYPRUSE_SCREENSHOT_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to expose only the observation tools (desktop, screenshot, zoom, ui, marks, binds, wait_for). The agent can see and narrate but cannot click, type, or launch.
environmentVariables.name: HYPRUSE_READONLY

environmentVariables.description: Restrict input to a scope of windows and refuse everything outside it: 'launched' (only windows hypruse opened this session), 'class:firefox,kitty', or 'workspace:3,special:notes'. Unset means no confinement.
environmentVariables.name: HYPRUSE_CONFINE

environmentVariables.description: Refuse to click or type into system authentication dialogs (polkit, keyring prompts). On by default; 'strict' also refuses password fields in ordinary windows; 0 disables it.
environmentVariables.name: HYPRUSE_AUTH_GUARD

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to refuse to act when the cursor or focused window moved since hypruse's last action, so the agent must re-read the desktop before retrying.
environmentVariables.name: HYPRUSE_STRICT

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to make the agent's presence legible: tag every window it opens 'hypruse-owned' and flash an on-screen notice when it opens a window or captures the screen.
environmentVariables.name: HYPRUSE_MARK

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to register the opt-in clipboard tool (never in read-only mode). Off by default because clipboards hold passwords.
environmentVariables.name: HYPRUSE_CLIPBOARD

environmentVariables.description: Record every tool call, refusals included, as one NDJSON line: 1 writes to XDG_STATE_HOME/hypruse/journal.ndjson, or give a path. Read it back with 'hypruse journal'. Off by default.
environmentVariables.name: HYPRUSE_JOURNAL

environmentVariables.description: Rotate the journal once it reaches this size, keeping one previous generation alongside it. Set 0 to never rotate.
environmentVariables.name: HYPRUSE_JOURNAL_MAX_BYTES

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to record typed and copied text in the journal verbatim instead of as a length plus digest. Off by default because keystrokes are passwords; needed only to replay typing.
environmentVariables.name: HYPRUSE_JOURNAL_TEXT

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 for a rehearsal: every acting tool validates its arguments and runs every trust guard, then reports what it would have done and delivers no input.
environmentVariables.name: HYPRUSE_DRYRUN
